body:
The diagram below shows the stages in the manufacture of wooden pencils, from raw timber to the finished product.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

chart.title: Manufacture of wooden pencils
steps: Cedar logs are sawn into long, thin planks
The planks are dried in kilns to remove moisture
Shallow grooves are cut along each plank
Graphite and clay are mixed and formed into thin rods
The rods are baked in an oven until they harden
Graphite rods are placed into the grooves
A second plank is glued on top to form a sandwich
The sandwich is cut into individual pencils and painted
The pencils are sharpened, packed and sent to retailers

body:
The diagram below shows the stages a research article passes through, from submission to publication in a peer-reviewed journal.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

chart.title: Stages in publishing a research article in a peer-reviewed journal
steps: Authors submit a manuscript to a journal
The editor checks whether the paper fits the journal's scope
Papers outside the scope are rejected without review
Suitable papers are sent to two or three referees
Referees read the paper and send written reports
The editor decides to accept, revise or reject
Papers needing changes return to the authors
Authors revise the paper and answer each comment
The revised version is checked again by referees
Accepted papers are copyedited and typeset
Authors check and approve the proofs
The article is published online and in print
